text:
it is very hard to find a man

who writes poems

that do not disappoint you.

Vallejo never disappointed me that way.


some say he died

from starving so much.


whatever

his poems about the terror of being

alone

are in a sense kind and

do not

shout.


we are tired of almost all

art.

Vallejo writes like a man

and not like an

artist.

he is beyond

our understanding.


I like to think Vallejo is still

alive and walking around the

room, I find

the sound of his steps firm.

imponderable.

translation.title: It Is Very Hard to Find a Man...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves Bukowski's plain praise of Vallejo as a man beyond artifice.
